metadata.description: LikeApplePLS: four skills for decks, product films, motion design and video edits, built on the way Apple makes its keynotes.

plugins.name: sebmake-keynote-likeapple-pls
plugins.description: Apple-keynote-style 16:9 decks plus the full speaker script, in your own branding.

plugins.name: sebmake-videopresentation-likeapplepls
plugins.description: A silent 1-2 minute product film cut like Apple's reveal films, plus 15-60 s versions in 16:9, 9:16 and 1:1.

plugins.name: sebmake-motiondesign-likeapplepls
plugins.description: Keynote motion measured frame by frame, turned into After Effects and EffectCraft scripts; narrated app walkthroughs built layer by layer.

plugins.name: sebmake-videoedit-like-applepls
plugins.description: Cuts your footage like Apple's keynote films in FilmCraft, Premiere or Resolve, assembles chapters with voice and ducked music, and reviews an edit.
